greenhouse:lyft:8648043002.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. 

 The divide between business needs and technical delivery is one of the most persistent challenges in enterprise technology, where People teams struggle to articulate requirements and engineering teams lack the business context to build truly impactful solutions. As a Senior Business Solution Architect for People at Lyft, you'll eliminate this gap by serving as the critical connection point between our People teams and our Corporate Engineering and IT (CEIT) organization. This customer obsessed role uniquely combines deep functional business expertise with strong technical acumen, with an AI native approach, enabling you to translate complex business needs into systemized, scalable solutions while driving AI-enabled transformation across the People function.

 We're seeking a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of business and technology, possesses exceptional communication skills across both technical and non-technical audiences, and is dedicated to architecting the future AI Native state of how the People function operates. You'll be the trusted advisor to both business leaders and engineering teams, ensuring our People organization has systems and processes that scale with our business while our engineering teams build solutions that truly move the needle. With AI fundamentally reshaping how the People function gets work done, your expertise will be critical in helping us responsibly harness these technologies to drive operational excellence. In this role, you'll reimagine People workflows through an AI-first lens, design business processes that balance operational excellence with technical feasibility, and champion automation that elevates teams from tactical execution to strategic impact.

 If you are a candidate who has the vision of what could be, who has the ability to cultivate relationships, and has a belief in driving impact, then you may be the ideal person for this position. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

 Responsibilities: 

- Architect People Solutions and Bridge Business-Technology Collaboration 

- Serve as the primary liaison between People stakeholders and engineering teams, translating both global and localized business needs into clear technical requirements taking an AI-Native approach and validating that delivered solutions meet business objectives.

- Maintain deep expertise in both People domain knowledge (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Onboarding, Learning & Development, Employee Experience) and the technical systems that support it (Workday, Greenhouse, CultureAmp, and various boundary applications), enabling effective communication across both audiences.

- Define the strategic roadmap for AI-First People systems, platforms, and data architecture in alignment with business strategy and technology capabilities.

- Design and document business processes that streamline workflows, eliminate redundancies, and improve operational efficiency while ensuring technical feasibility.

- Develop comprehensive business requirements documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

- Drive AI-Enabled Transformation Across People 

- Partner with People leaders to reimagine processes through an AI-first lens, prototyping solutions that demonstrate art-of-the-possible and building conviction for change.

- Identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across People workflows, from candidate screening and onboarding to personalized learning and predictive retention analysis, pushing teams up the value chain by eliminating mundane, repetitive work.

- Establish frameworks for responsible AI adoption within People, ensuring solutions align with compliance, data privacy, security guidelines, and ethical considerations.

- Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and tools, continuously researching how new models and platforms can be applied to People use cases.

- Enable Strategic Decision-Making and Platform Optimization 

- Develop business cases that quantify ROI for technology investments, translating technical capabilities into tangible business value metrics.

- Lead People systems architecture discussions, providing guidance on integrations, data flows, technical dependencies, and impact of proposed changes.

- Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure People solutions adhere to data privacy, audit standards, and regulatory obligations related to employee data.

- Support M&A integration efforts by assessing acquired companies' People systems and architecting integration roadmaps that minimize business disruption.

 Experience: 

- 8+ years of experience in business solution architecture, business process design, People/HR systems implementation, or related roles, with deep expertise in People operations and systems.

- Experience with AI/automation in business contexts, including familiarity with LLMs, intelligent automation tools, or AI-powered workflow solutions.

- Proven track record translating complex business requirements into technical solutions, working at the intersection of People teams and engineering.

- Strong technical foundation including understanding of system architecture, APIs, data modeling, integration patterns, and modern SaaS platforms.

- Demonstrated success leading business process transformation initiatives in People/HR that delivered measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, or user experience.

- Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, from explaining technical concepts to CHRO and People executives to providing detailed specifications to engineers.

- Preferred Qualifications 

- Hands-on experience with core People enterprise systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Dayforce, or similar platforms.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Workato, automation platforms like UiPath or Power Automate)

- Experience with change management and driving adoption of new systems or processes across large People organizations.

- Background in product management, solution architecture, or technical program management.

- Experience in high-growth tech companies or organizations undergoing significant digital transformation.

- M&A integration experience, particularly People systems consolidation and harmonization.

greenhouse:lyft:8827588002.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 The autonomous transition is a transformational opportunity for Lyft. Our strategy focuses on becoming the preferred marketplace, fleet, and operational partner for the world's best Autonomous Vehicle (AV) providers. As AV deployments scale across new markets, the operational infrastructure that enables safe, compliant, and high-quality service becomes a critical competitive advantage. This role sits at the heart of that infrastructure - owning the systems, processes, and partner alignment that allow Lyft to operate at the standards our AV partners require and our riders expect.

 As a qualified candidate, you have a track record of building and running complex operational programs in highly regulated or standards-driven environments. You are energized by cross-functional complexity - comfortable leading structured implementation processes that span many teams while keeping a clear eye on compliance and quality outcomes. You bring a program management mindset, strong stakeholder communication skills, and the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving industry.

 Responsibilities: 

- Own execution of AV partner audits end-to-end. That includes evidence collection, submission, partner and third-party review, mitigation oversight, and closeout, across concurrent certification cycles for multiple markets and AV partners, domestic and international.

- Act as a strategic leader within the company to support cross-functional teams’ compliance controls and readiness for partner scrutiny

- Drive coordination across teams including EHS, Legal, Safety, HR, IT and Operations for every deliverable. Translate partner and regulatory requirements into concrete, assignable asks and ensure deadlines are met

- Maintain and continuously improve the audit tracking system, including the evidence library, audit trail, and submission tooling. Lead platform improvements as volume and complexity grow

- Identify non-conforming items surfaced during audits, assist in identifying mitigation, and track corrective actions with the owning function through to closure

- Manage the logistics and stakeholder prep for audits, including document readiness and staff interviews 

- Build repeatable playbooks so each new market or partner audit cycle runs faster and with less rework than the last

- Report clearly and credibly on timelines and risk to leadership on behalf of AV Operational Excellence

- Act as the primary audit point of contact for AV partners 

 Experience: 

- 5+ years in program management, compliance, quality assurance, or audit-adjacent roles within a regulated or standards-driven environment

- A track record of driving structured, deadline-driven cross-functional work without formal authority over contributing teams. Comfortable pushing partners to deliver and escalating when needed

- Strong command of audit and evidence management mechanics: tracking systems, documentation rigor, version control, and chain-of-custody type discipline

- Experience with spreadsheet or database-driven tracking systems, and interest in modernizing them

- Prior exposure to AV, automotive, aviation, or another safety-critical, audited industry strongly preferred

- This is an individual contributor role at launch, with room to grow into leading a small team as certification volume scales

- Mental health benefits

- Child care and pet benefits

greenhouse:lyft:8621699002.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-sharing and scooter-sharing systems that move millions of people in over 60 cities worldwide. We built North America's first automated bike-share system and continue to lead the micromobility revolution. Our systems operate globally - from Citi Bike in New York to BIXI in Montreal, Divvy in Chicago, Capital Bikeshare in DC, and iconic systems in Austin, Barcelona, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubai, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto, and beyond.

 We're not just technology providers - we operate these systems, building the software, hardware, and operations that make urban micromobility work at scale.

 Ready to shape how millions of people move through their cities every day?

 The Hardware Product and Industrial Design Team at LUS is responsible for conceiving, guiding development of, launching, and sustaining world-class products used by riders, cities, and operators over the world.  We represent LUS in micromobility forums, engage directly with customers, and guide research and development.  We aim to ensure all products we develop are delightful for riders, globally competitive, elegant, and future-facing.

 We are looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager, Hardware to manage our existing stations portfolio as well as develop our next generation of stations products.  Our stations are now as iconic in cityscapes as London Routemaster buses of old.  You will have end-to-end ownership of new station product development, leading a cross-functional team through all phases of hardware development to launch, and will be responsible for a fleet of over 300,000 charging and non-charging station assets already on the ground.   You will engage directly with LUS leadership, engineering, data science, operations, and design to achieve the company’s vision for reinventing transportation.  You will work closely with our Vehicles Product Manager, Industrial Design team, and counterparts in software product management to ensure our entire ecosystem of products functions cohesively. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and passionate candidate to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from Montreal or Longueuil, where the first automated bikeshare system in North America was developed.

- Lead and align cross functional partners and teams: engineers, operators, designers, data scientists, marketers, and business partners to drive a shared vision for new station hardware products, and ongoing sustaining work on in-market products

- Understand Lyft's strategic and competitive position in order to set team goals, success metrics and roadmap to align with Lyft's mission and drive maximum impact based on data analysis, market research and usability studies

- Identify and resolve systemic product issues impacting Lyft markets and customers and aggressively take action to resolve

- Communicate clear roadmaps, priorities, experiments and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executives

- Represent Lyft in external forums and with customers to drive adoption of our products

- Work closely with counterparts in software product management, program management, and other related functions to develop best-in-class, cohesive experiences for riders, operators, and cities

 Experience: 

- 5-6+ years experience in product management, product design or equivalent consulting experience

- Unafraid to ask questions, regardless of what others will think about it

- Passion for micromobility and what we are trying to achieve in sustainable urban transportation

- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field or relevant work experience preferred

- Experience developing and deploying end to end hardware products is a plus, but not required

- Experience with micromobility vehicles and platforms is a plus, but not required

- Natural ability to make things happen around you. You manage project ambiguity, complexity and interdependencies in an organized and structured way. Be able to define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products

- Excellent judgment and thoughtfulness about the dynamics of a product ecosystem

- Strong communication skills and intuition for communication strategy at every level - within teams, within the company, to users, to press, and other audiences

- Experience leading post-launch optimizations including developing testing and product improvement strategies is a plus, but not required

- Ability to conceptualize, manage and prioritize multiple projects for stakeholders

- Detail oriented with superior organizational skills - balancing multiple projects, deadlines, and requests should be second nature to you

 Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our Toronto office.

 Every great support experience depends on the person behind it having the right tools, context, and intelligence to solve the problem in front of them. The Platform & Data teams build the tools our human support agents work in every day—and own the data that tells Lyft, and the world, what our customers are actually experiencing. As AI rapidly changes what's possible, we're reinventing how agents work: pairing them with copilots and AI that surface the right answer instantly, take on repetitive work, and raise the quality and consistency of every interaction. At the same time, we're building the data foundation that turns millions of support contacts into an accurate, trusted view of issue types and trends—used inside the team, across the company, and in what we report externally. greenhouse:instacart:8275378.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 The Associate Product Operations Manager (APOM) is the delivery layer of Product Ops. That means you own your workstreams from intake to handoff, with the kind of discipline and rigor that makes downstream teams trust what comes from you.

 The core scope includes: PCR intake and triage, Product Enablement Package (PEP) production, and launch readiness. You run the PCR lifecycle with quality and care. You write PEPs that people actually use. You take pride in clean handoffs.

 This is a rotation-based role. Every 6-12 months you move to a new vertical pod: Consumer, Shopper, Enterprise. You build real product sense across all of them. Each rotation is a workstream you own end-to-end, not a support assignment. That breadth is what sets you up for the next level.

 AI fluency isn't optional, but instead it's how the team works and works faster. You use AI tools regularly to accelerate your core deliverables, and you know the difference between a draft that's ready and one that still needs your judgment.

 About the Team 

 Product Operations is organized into three pillars: Vertical Partnership Pods, Intelligence & Systems (the Horizontal), and the Enablement Team. This role is within the Enablement Team.

 The Enablement Team is the shared engine that keeps launches moving. It's a centralized pool of team members, deployed to wherever priorities are highest. We execute inside the verticals, use the infrastructure the Horizontal builds, and feed back the cross-domain patterns we see across rotations. Our work is foundational to the team's promise of making outcomes more likely, faster, and more durable.

 Your manager manages your deployments and development. Your pod partners are your day-to-day collaborators. The Horizontal is the infrastructure team and your systems partner.

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

- Own PCR intake end-to-end: validate problem statements, assess routing, and make sure everything is clean before it hits a vertical pod

- Handle Tier 2 triage, the judgment calls that go beyond what the automated system can resolve on its own

- Write and maintain PEPs, using AI-assisted drafts as your starting point and owning the quality, accuracy, and stakeholder fit of the final version

- Drive launch readiness in your assigned area, coordinating with stakeholders so the people who depend on launches aren't caught off guard

- Pull together customer signal and quality data into structured summaries that feed the Horizontal's intelligence work

- Run PRDs through the PRD enabler and deliver results to POMs and Product with clear framing, not just raw output

- Surface at least one cross-domain insight to the Horizontal per deployment — you're in a unique position to see patterns across pods, and that's part of the job

- Use AI as a real part of your workflow: for triage, drafting, research, onboarding — and always edit before you share

- Build the kind of cross-domain product sense across your rotations that's the foundation for cluster ownership at L5

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 4+ years in product operations, project management, business analytics, or related field, preferably in a technology or product-driven environment.

- Hands-on experience with Jira or a similar project management tool 

- Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in SQL and proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets.

- Demonstrated use of AI-driven or automation tools to streamline operations.

- Proven ability to collaborate across functions, communicate effectively, and advocate for customers.

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 

- Experience in go-to-market planning or product launch operations.

- Prior success in a tech, SaaS, consumer product, or marketplace company.

- Familiarity with BI and data visualization platforms (e.g., Mode, Looker, Tableau).

- Experience establishing customer feedback mechanisms to drive process or product improvements.

- Demonstrated initiative and ownership for cross-team process improvements or automations.

 Overview 

 Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

 People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

 This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

 About the Job 

 Run the operating rhythm 

- Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.

- Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.

- Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.

- Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).

- Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).

- Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.

- Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.

- Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

 Plan executive communication 

- Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.

- Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

 Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health 

- Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.

- Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.

- Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

 Drive priority programs 

- Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.

- Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.

- Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 10+ years of work experience 

- R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization

- Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives

- Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.

- High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level

- Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.

- Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.

- Ability to travel 10% 

 Preferred Experience 

- Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.

- Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.

- Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

 Instacart’s enterprise business is at an inflection point. Retailers and CPG brands are navigating a rapidly shifting grocery landscape—and the demand for Instacart’s ecommerce, fulfillment, in-store, retail media, AI and data solutions has never been greater. We’re hiring a Director of B2B Enterprise Product Marketing to be the strategic engine behind how we bring this platform to market.  Overview 

 About the Team 

 Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

 About the Role 

 We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success  — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.

 About the Job 

- Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.

- Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

- Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

- Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.

- Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

- Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.

- Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).

- Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.

- Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).

- Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.

- Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.

- Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.

- Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

 Overview

 Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. As a Senior Design Program Manager, you'll drive operational excellence and programmatic execution across the Design organization—building AI-enabled systems, scaling critical processes, and managing the tools and vendor relationships that power our creative work.

 This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll work closely with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team, requiring technical fluency to bridge design, engineering, and tooling infrastructure.

 About the Role

 You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

 You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

 About the Job

- Programmatic Execution: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.

- AI Enablement: Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management tasks—status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Champion AI fluency in Design to accelerate design-first thinking and increase operational efficiency.

- Operations & Vendor Management: Own strategic vendor relationships and contract management for design tooling (Figma, prototyping, asset management, collaboration platforms). Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.

- Systems & Tooling: Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.

- Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.

- Design Craft Integration: Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

 About You

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.

- Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market. 

- Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.

- (component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)

- Technical fluency to collaborate with design system and engineering teams—understanding system architecture, component APIs, design-to-code workflows, and technical constraints

- Proven track record driving complex, cross-functional programs from 0→1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments

- AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs

- Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance

- Deep knowledge of design and program management tooling ecosystems (Figma, Linear, Jira, Dovetail, asset management, prototyping tools)

- Ability to drive organizational change and influence cross-functional partners—bringing clarity to complexity

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to executive leadership

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Design systems expertise: building/scaling systems, managing component libraries, defining tokens, driving adoption programs

- Experience building AI-powered workflows for creative operations or design tooling integrations

- Success translating leadership vision into actionable roadmaps and operating models

- Experience in hybrid/embedded team models with deep cross-functional partnership

- Comfort balancing hands-on execution with strategic oversight

- Track record using data and storytelling to influence leadership and secure buy-in for operational investments

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.  Overview 

 Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, enabling Instacart and its retailer partners to deliver highly relevant, effective advertising experiences at scale. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll sit at the intersection of machine learning, marketplace dynamics, and measurable business impact — helping shape the future of how brands connect with shoppers across the Instacart platform.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the systems that drive core auction understanding and marketplace balance within our Ads Quality domain. This is a high-impact, technically complex space where your work will directly influence the health of the ads ecosystem — from how auctions are structured and optimized to how quality signals inform ranking and relevance. You'll partner closely with a team of talented machine learning engineers and ads engineers who are building at the frontier of what's possible in retail media.

 If you're energized by ambiguous, high-stakes problems, fluent in the language of ML and online advertising, and eager to accelerate experimentation in a fast-moving environment — this is the role for you.

 About the Job 

- Own the product vision and roadmap for ads quality systems, including auction mechanics, marketplace balance, and the signals that govern ad ranking and relevance across Instacart's retail media network.

- Drive the strategy and execution for increasing the velocity of experimentation across the ads quality team — designing frameworks that allow the team to test, learn, and iterate faster without sacrificing rigor or integrity.

- Work hands-on with machine learning engineers and ads engineers to translate complex ML model outputs and auction dynamics into clear product requirements, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.

- Define and track the right success metrics for ads quality, navigating tradeoffs between advertiser performance, shopper experience, and marketplace health — and communicating those tradeoffs clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where priorities shift, new data surfaces frequently, and the ability to make good decisions under uncertainty is essential to moving the business forward.

 About You 

 Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of product management experience in online advertising, ad tech, or a closely related domain — with a demonstrated understanding of auction mechanics, bidding systems, or ad quality signals.

- 2+ years of experience working directly with machine learning teams or ML-driven products, with the ability to engage substantively in technical conversations about model design, evaluation, and tradeoffs.

- Proven track record of defining and executing on product roadmaps in complex, data-rich environments with multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions, measure impact, and design experiments.

 Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and how they can be applied within ads or ranking systems.

- Experience working with ads machine learning models in a production environment, including relevance scoring, auction optimization, or quality filtering.

- Prior experience at a retail media network, demand-side platform, or supply-side platform, with exposure to the full advertising stack.

- Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where structure and process are still being built — and an eagerness to help build them.

- Serve as a primary product point of contact in external conversations with advertisers and agency partners — sharing roadmap direction, gathering strategic feedback, and helping to nurture relationships that inform product decisions and drive trust in the platform.

- Grow into a senior PM lead for the Advertiser Experience team over time, including providing strategic guidance and serving as a thought partner to a more junior PM on the team, as you demonstrate command of your scope and expand your ownership footprint.

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of independently owning complex, cross-functional product areas.

- Experience building or owning B2B platform products, including enterprise UX flows and underlying platform infrastructure.

- Strong technical acumen — comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams on system design, APIs, and platform architecture.

- Experience managing external partner or customer relationships as part of a product role, not just internal stakeholders.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business context for both engineering teams and executive audiences.

We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 Instacart+ is Instacart's membership program, the connective tissue between the brand and its most loyal, high-value customers. With benefits like $0 delivery fees, partner perks, and exclusive savings, Instacart+ is the foundation of our long-term customer relationship strategy. Members shop more, spend more, and stay longer, and this role is responsible for making sure more customers become Instacart+ members and realize the benefits of doing so. 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the full go-to-market strategy for Instacart+. You'll shape how we position, message, and grow the membership program from acquisition campaigns that convert first-timers to lifecycle strategies that deepen engagement with existing members. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of product, brand, and growth.

 The ideal candidate has deep roots in subscription or loyalty marketing, having grown a membership program, driven retention through value communication, and knows how to make the math of membership feel like a no-brainer to a consumer. You bring both the analytical rigor to understand what's working and the storytelling instinct to make it resonate. This role reports to the Director, Consumer Product Marketing.

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

- Own the Instacart+ differentiated positioning that sets it apart from competing membership and subscription offerings.   

- Members have a reason to stay: you've identified the moments where member value is highest and built messaging and lifecycle programs that bring those moments to life across email, push, in-app, and paid. 

- Acquisition is measurably stronger: you've partnered with growth and performance marketing teams to develop and test messaging frameworks that convert trial users and lapsed members into committed subscribers.

- The product roadmap reflects member insights: you've become the internal voice of the Instacart+ member, bringing qualitative and quantitative research into roadmap conversations that shape what gets built next.

- New Instacart+ features launch with best-in-class GTM plans: you own the brief, the messaging, and the channel strategy from kickoff through post-launch performance review.

- Senior stakeholders and XFN partners trust you as the category expert: you've developed a compelling POV on the subscription and loyalty landscape and use it to sharpen the Instacart+ strategy.

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 Must-have pantry staples 

 Minimum Qualifications 

- 8+ years of progressive experience in marketing, with at least 4+ years in product marketing; experience at a consumer tech company is strongly preferred. 

- Demonstrated track record owning GTM strategy for a subscription, membership, or loyalty program, from positioning through lifecycle, with measurable results.

- Deep fluency in subscription/loyalty marketing mechanics: you understand member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and churn, and know how to use marketing to move each lever.

- A sharp strategic mind that can synthesize consumer research, behavioral data, and competitive signals into positioning and messaging that cuts through

- Proven ability to influence product roadmaps. You've brought the voice of the customer into planning cycles and shaped what gets built, not just how it gets marketed.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting and defending strategy to VP and C-suite stakeholders.

- Experience partnering closely with growth, lifecycle/CRM, creative, and data science teams to develop and execute multi-channel campaigns

- Proficient in using data and A/B testing to develop and iterate on messaging; as comfortable in a metrics dashboard as in a creative brief

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

 Optional garnishes 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience marketing a subscription or loyalty program in a marketplace or two-sided platform context (e.g., retail, food delivery, grocery)

- Background working on programs with tiered benefits, earn/burn mechanics, or partner integrations

- Experience running or partnering on member research, including surveys, focus groups, UXR to surface insights that directly inform strategy

greenhouse:block:5371509008.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 The Role 

 Block's Canada Compliance team is building a scalable, technology-enabled compliance function for our regulated Canadian entities - Square Canada and Afterpay Canada. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, Canada, and serving as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements, you will be a “full-stack” compliance leader: driving the annual compliance plan end-to-end, overseeing frameworks across AML/ATF, sanctions, the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), consumer protection, privacy, and payment card industry obligations, and co-building the AI-enabled programs and tools that keep both entities aligned with Canadian regulatory expectations and Block's global standards.

 You Will 

- Serve as the Regulatory Program Lead for Block's Canadian regulated entities, acting as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements

- Lead end-to-end execution of the annual Canada Compliance Plan -  regulatory change management, monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and policy reviews - delivering against key milestones and regulatory commitments

- Run Canada's compliance programs across AML/ATF (Square Canada MSB), RPAA, the PCI Code of Conduct, and consumer protection and privacy obligations (PIPEDA, CASL, FCAC, provincial requirements), including FINTRAC registration and support for regulatory examinations and audits

- Lead governance and tracking of regulatory commitments, audit actions, and findings - driving issue management and remediation through to closure - while maintaining the compliance risk assessment framework, policies, and governance documentation

- Prepare Board and governance committee materials, translating multi-domain regulatory complexity into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership

- Lead cross-functional regulatory programs across Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, and Engineering, driving operational excellence through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled compliance solutions

- Coordinate compliance training and targeted regulatory awareness materials for senior leadership, Boards, and business stakeholders

 You Have 

- 10+ years of progressive experience in compliance, financial crime, or regulatory affairs, which must include payments compliance at a regulated payments entity - an MSB, payment service provider, acquirer, or comparable fintech such as Square Canada and serving in, or directly supporting, a senior compliance leadership role (CCO, Deputy CCO, Head of Compliance, CAMLO / Deputy CAMLO)

- Deep knowledge of Canadian AML/ATF legislation (PCMLTFA, FINTRAC guidance), the RPAA, the Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada, consumer protection frameworks (FCAC, PIPEDA, CASL), and Canadian sanctions regimes (SEMA, UN sanctions)

- Executive presence, with experience preparing and presenting Board-level compliance reporting and engaging directly with regulators through examinations and ongoing supervision

- Direct end-to-end working knowledge of payment systems, money services businesses - including payments-specific financial crime typologies and controls

- Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI tools for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation - with sound judgment about their limits

- A builder mindset with proven leadership, people management, and stakeholder engagement capabilities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment; CAMS, ICA, or equivalent certification

- Bonus points: knowledge of buy-now-pay-later compliance programs, Quebec regulatory regime, hands-on RPAA compliance, OSFI guidelines, the AUSTRAC / Australian AML/CTF regime, or bilingual English/French

 Technologies We Use and Teach 

- Protecht (GRC / issue and risk management)

- AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT / OpenAI Enterprise / GitHub) for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation

- JIRA and Confluence (program and documentation management)

- Looker / Tableau (reporting and dashboards)

greenhouse:stripe:7984866.description:
Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 The Ecosystem Risk Product Management team sits at the intersection of growth and protection. Our focus is twofold. We enable online businesses—including those in emerging and regulated industries—to start and grow on Stripe, while protecting consumers, merchants, and partners from financial crimes. We build financial infrastructure at scale that powers every transaction on Stripe, deliver merchant-facing UI and API experiences, and develop AI-driven solutions to some of the hardest and most exciting challenges in the digital economy.

 What you'll do

 Responsibilities

- Own the vision and multi-year roadmap for AI-powered financial crimes controls—spanning detection, investigation, information collection, and the UI and API surfaces that tie them together.

- Build core infrastructure that underpins Stripe's growing suite of products and services. • Develop investigator tools that power accurate case reviews using the best of AI and human expertise.

- Drive cross-functional execution by partnering closely with engineering, operations, design, data science, go-to-market, legal, and product teams across Stripe.

- Define and own success metrics, navigate complex trade-offs, drive prioritization, and measure outcomes with rigor to demonstrate impact.

- Align leadership and stakeholders by synthesizing input from across the organization and external sources, and communicating a clear point of view to peers and executives.

- Monitor the external landscape—regulatory trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings—to inform strategy and identify opportunities.

 Who you are

 Minimum requirements

- 7+ years in Product Management

- Proven experience building infrastructure and user experiences at scale

- Track record of operating effectively in highly cross-functional environments

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

 Preferred qualifications

- Experience in financial crimes or fraud prevention within financial services

 About the team 

 Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.

 We are looking to hire a Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market strategy and drive adoption for Stripe's data products — including Sigma, Data Pipeline, Database, and new products we’re incubating. As monetization grows more complex — from AI companies hyperscaling globally to enterprises integrating Stripe deeply into their operations — data has become a critical lever that helps businesses make better decisions.

 What you'll do 

 As a key owner of our GTM strategy for Stripe's data products, you'll need to quickly build a deep understanding of our products, the data analytics buyer, and our competitive differentiation. You will:

- Be the expert on our data analytics buyers — understand how data analysts, analytics engineers, and BI practitioners evaluate and adopt tools, and translate those insights into product roadmap recommendations and GTM strategy.

- Own positioning and messaging for Stripe's data products, building a clear and differentiated point of view in a competitive market.

- Drive end-to-end go-to-market for data product launches — from defining the narrative and target audience to developing the assets and programs that drive adoption across sold and self-serve motions.

- Partner with demand generation and campaigns to design and execute programs that reach the data analytics buyer and accelerate product adoption at scale.

- Build sales enablement — develop the messaging frameworks, competitive battlecards, and assets that help sales teams clearly articulate the value of Stripe's data products.

- Own competitive intelligence for the analytics and BI landscape, tracking competitors and turning that intelligence into differentiated positioning and sales tools.

- Define program KPIs and maintain accountability to measurable business outcomes across the data products portfolio.

 Minimum requirements 

- 10+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B tech.

- A builder mentality with a strong bias to action. Comfortable with ambiguity, able to experiment and adapt at pace.

- Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of distilling complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive and external audiences.

- Exceptional cross-functional leadership and ability to influence across all levels and functions, from senior leadership to project teams.

- High comfort toggling between strategy and execution — big picture to fine detail.

- Proven ability to translate customer and market insights into differentiated positioning and measurable GTM programs.

 Preferred qualifications 

- Deep familiarity with the data analytics ecosystem — BI tools, cloud data warehouses, and analytics workflows — and a proven ability to market to the data analyst or analytics engineer buyer.

- Experience marketing to technical audiences such as data engineers, analytics engineers, or developers.

- Power user (and builder) of AI-powered tooling.

Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 Sail Core builds Stripe's frontend platform—the data layer, navigation, observability, and developer tooling that 50+ product teams use to ship web applications, with the Dashboard being the largest. We are responsible for enabling a stellar developer experience for frontend engineers at Stripe. We're hiring a deeply technical product manager to own the platform strategy, drive cross-company modernization initiatives, and set the standard for frontend excellence at Stripe.

 What you'll do

 How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? When do you invest in long-term architectural health versus shipping the migration that unblocks next quarter's goal? How do you make 9,000 files at initialization become a fast, traceable, joyful developer experience—without breaking production for millions of merchants along the way?

 Responsibilities

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for Stripe's frontend platform

- Drive the largest frontend modernization initiative at Stripe while holding the line on architectural quality

- Redefine frontend development with agentic tooling

- Define and track key metrics such as latency, build times, and reliability SLOs to make difficult trade-off decisions

- Be the product voice in deeply technical decisions such as API surface design, framework deprecation sequencing, extraction boundaries, and migration tooling

 Who you are

 You think in systems, not features. You go deep on architecture, you don't delegate to engineering. You're the person who reads the RFC before the meeting, asks why the error response looks like that, and frames migrations in terms of user outcomes, not just engineering milestones. You treat developer experience as part of the product, not a byproduct.

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

- 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or developer tools teams

- Strong technical fluency in frontend web development—you discuss JavaScript and TypeScript, React component models, build systems, and performance optimization with depth

- Experience driving large-scale migrations or platform transitions across multiple teams, including the sequencing, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment that make them succeed

- Demonstrated use of quantitative metrics to drive platform investment decisions—you've defined the metrics, not just tracked them

- Track record of partnering with engineering to make architectural trade-offs grounded in user impact

 Preferred qualifications

- Engineering background—you've written frontend code professionally and it still shapes how you think about product decisions

- Led or significantly contributed to a legacy extraction or monolith decomposition effort and understand viscerally why they're hard and where they get stuck

- Believe that fast software is the best software

- Naturally default to the platform solution over the one-off fix, but know when speed demands the opposite

- Explain what a cascading re-render is, why it matters, and what to do about it—to an engineer, a designer, and a VP, in three different ways

greenhouse:okta:8247721.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Role Overview 

 AI is rapidly changing how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, deployed, and operated — and the industry playbook is being rewritten monthly. Okta's Developer Productivity and AI Enablement Engineering teams own building and operating the capabilities that make our engineers fast across the inner and outer development loops. This role is the product counterpart, embedded full-time with that organization, that makes those investments compound by uncovering and prioritizing frictions, bringing the outside in, driving standardize-vs-federate decisions, spreading what works across teams, funding and clearing the path for the best tools, and proving the value.

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to own developer productivity as a product across Okta's development lifecycle — AI-native and traditional tooling alike. You will start bottom-up: interviewing engineers, managers, tech leads, and architects; mapping current inner- and outer-loop tooling and the frictions; and baselining dev-cycle metrics. From there, you will own the roadmap with engineering leadership; benchmark how the best engineering organizations build with AI; define tooling requirements and/or run the tooling evaluations engineering needs in a landscape that changes monthly; find the teams inside Okta getting outsized results and turn their patterns into playbooks; lead build, buy, integrate, and standardize decisions, including the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0; clear the security, legal, procurement, and budget paths that slow adoption; and own the measurement that connects investment to engineering outcomes — evidence engineering leaders can take into any room.

 This is a highly technical internal platform role that creates value for Okta through a cross-team, cross-industry, cross-functional layer that turns individual wins into organizational capability.

 What You'll Do 

- Product Strategy & Discovery: Own the vision, PRDs, and prioritized backlog for Okta's internal developer productivity and AI tooling. Treat engineers as your customers: start with deep, bottom-up discovery (dozens of engineer, EM, tech lead, and architect interviews), baseline dev-cycle metrics, and secure tooling budgets with rigorous, ROI-driven business cases.

- Ecosystem Validation (Build vs. Buy): Drive definitive "adopt, build, or pass" decisions. Run hands-on, structured evaluations of inner- and outer-loop tooling — from coding agents and MCPs to build, CI/CD, and code review systems — against strict security and TCO criteria to ensure internal investments amplify vendor capabilities.

- Hands-On Execution: Embed full-time with Developer Productivity Engineering and own the roadmap jointly with its engineering leads. Define MVP scopes, manage sprints, and incrementally ship workflows. You own the strategy and requirements (the what and why); Engineering owns the technical execution (the how).

- Adoption & Outcomes: Own org-wide adoption, clearing security, legal, and privacy hurdles along the way. Measure success by connecting tool usage directly to hard engineering outcomes (cycle time, quality, toil reduction).

- Standardization & Lighthouses: Coordinate the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0 engineering. Study high-performing teams to see who is getting exceptional results, and convert those patterns into scalable playbooks that shift the broader org from passive AI use to agentic workflows.

 What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience with developer platforms, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI products.

- Experience owning internal or platform products where users have alternatives — adoption driven through product quality rather than mandate.

- Strong understanding of modern software development workflows — source control, IDEs, CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, production operations — across the inner and outer loops of development.

- Hands-on, current fluency with AI-assisted software development — coding agents, context management, MCP, evaluation frameworks — and informed views on where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk.

- Demonstrated ability to design and run technology evaluations and controlled experiments, and to define measurement systems for developer productivity with judgment about their failure modes.

- Ability to engage credibly in technical and architectural discussions with senior engineers while maintaining clear boundaries between product outcomes and engineering implementation.

- Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, security, architecture, and finance without direct authority.

- Excellent written communication in a docs-first culture; you can produce solid action plans from incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience deploying or scaling developer tools across a large, multi-org engineering organization — including consolidating divergent stacks and the change management that comes with it.

- Hands-on familiarity with developer AI tools, harnesses, APIs, MCPs, and agent orchestration frameworks.

- Familiarity with developer productivity research (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and its failure modes.

- Experience establishing governance, evaluation frameworks, or spend management for rapidly evolving, consumption-priced technologies.

 Why This Role Matters 

 AI-assisted development is becoming both one of the largest levers on engineering velocity and one of the largest new variable costs in R&D. The playbook changes monthly, and the organizations that win are the ones that learn fastest from the outside, spread what works internally, and measure honestly. That learning-and-leverage layer doesn't build itself — engineering teams optimizing locally, however well, still leave organizational value uncaptured and accumulate divergent implementations that slow everyone down.

 This role exists to capture it: dedicated product leadership that brings engineering the external intelligence, funded tooling, cleared paths, shared patterns, and defensible evidence to build with AI faster than any single team could alone — while deepening Okta's firsthand credibility as the company that secures the AI-powered enterprise for its customers.

**Must attend in person orientation in person the first Tuesday of employment. If you are in Toronto, orientation is in Toronto. If you are in Dublin, orientation is in Dublin. 
**Must go into the local office 2 days a week.
**Must work North American hours.

This position requires a strong technical foundation, keen product intuition, cybersecurity knowledge, and exceptional collaboration skills to shape the future of our strategic security products. You'll leverage significant cross-functional influence to execute key initiatives in this critical domain.

 Built upon the robust Okta Identity Cloud, our mission is to ensure Okta provides the most comprehensive, user-friendly, admin-friendly, and secure Identity Security product suite available. This team is responsible for products including Okta Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI , Okta ThreatInsight , and Okta Network Zones , among other vital security functionalities. Our customers depend on these solutions to safeguard their digital assets and ensure secure access for their users. This role is pivotal in ensuring that security is seamlessly integrated into every facet of our products.

 Success in this role demands a deep understanding of customer security requirements, a strong empathy for both end-user and administrator experiences, and the ability to strategically prioritize amidst competing demands from various Okta teams.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Roadmap and Vision 

- Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.

- Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.

- Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.

- Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

 Product Delivery and Execution 

- Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.

- Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.

- Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.

- Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.

- Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

 Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering 

- Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.

- Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.

- Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.

- Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.

- Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.

- Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

 Own the Product 

- Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.

- Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.

- Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.

- Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.

- Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.

- Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.

- Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).

- Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.

- Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.

- Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.

- Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.

- Strong technical background that allows you to influence technical design and investment decisions, particularly in security architectures.

- Ability to produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous security inputs.

- Strong track record of influencing teams and operating effectively as a player-coach.

- Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences, especially when discussing complex security concepts.

- Strong leadership skills and executive presence.

- Passion for Okta’s immense opportunity and growth potential in the identity security market.

- 8+ years product management experience.

- Experience interviewing and selecting candidates.

- Mentoring early-in-career product managers.

 Preferred: 

- Advanced degree in a technical or business field.

- Deep knowledge of enterprise security products and services, including cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

- Extensive knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) and its intersection with security.

- Understanding of authentication, authorization, and threat detection standards.

- Experience with developing user flows and enabling customizable security experiences.

- Experience creating and managing multi-tenant SaaS security software products.
