ashby:rewind:182ea3c9-5a23-44b4-a82d-14a.title: Product Marketing Manager
ashby:rewind:182ea3c9-5a23-44b4-a82d-14a.description:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50 https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/about/press-room/deloitte-canada-announces-its-annual-technology-fast-50tm-program-winners.html). We invite you to read our startup story https://rewind.io/blog/why-we-started-rewind-backups/ to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here https://rewind.com/about-us/.
To find out more about our perks, click here https://rewind.com/careers/#:~:text=Working%20at%20Rewind%20has%20its%20perks.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

 - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About the role

This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales.

We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest.

We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way.

What you'll do

Launches and go-to-market

 - Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch.

 - Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones.

 - Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming.

 - Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change.

Positioning and messaging

 - Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas.

 - Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence.

 - Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work.

Buyer and competitive insight

 - Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions.

 - Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading.

 - Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market.

Sales and partner enablement

 - Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece.

 - Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work.

AI-powered product marketing

 - Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets.

 - Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse.

 - Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities.

What you'll bring

 - 4+ years of product marketing experience in B2B, including product launches, positioning and messaging.

 - Sales enablement experience, such as training sellers and building the battlecards and collateral they rely on.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, or a clear appetite to learn them fast. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach.

 - Experience working with product teams to define product strategy.

 - Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus.

 - Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling.

 - A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers.

 - Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in.

 - Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly.

 - Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Nice to have

 - Experience building AI workflows or automations for a marketing or sales team.



Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.



Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

 - Flexible work hours

 - Employee stock options

 - Health benefits

 - 3 weeks vacation

 - 7 life leave days

 - 2 Level Up days for professional development

 - 1 volunteer day

 - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

 - Paid parental leave

 - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

 - $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.



AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

ashby:jane:2d2a4d4b-25d1-4eb8-8c3b-6cd65.title: Senior PM - Communications
ashby:jane:2d2a4d4b-25d1-4eb8-8c3b-6cd65.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hey, I'm Liam https://www.linkedin.com/in/liamdmcdonald/, Group PM for Communications at Jane. I'm a New Zealander who's called Vancouver home for over 8 years, and outside of work you'll find me doing all the classic Pacific Northwest things: 50+ ski days a year, with the rest filled by hiking, biking and beaches (a sign of my Kiwi roots). I've spent most of my career building communications products in healthcare, and the rest in marketing automation. I came to Jane for the chance to shape the future of Jane and healthcare communication, and nine months in, both the opportunity and my excitement have only grown.

This role exists because our ambitions for Communications are growing. Much of a clinic's patient communication still happens outside of Jane, and it's one of the biggest demands on their time. You'll focus on net new areas, like additional channels, that bring more of that communication into Jane, and on where AI can help clinics stay on top of it. Alongside both, you'll contribute to some of our existing domains, like our Notifications Centre.

Our group is full of zero-to-one builders who are helping to shape the future of Jane and of healthcare, and you'll play a key role in that. You'll own a problem space end-to-end and take new products from idea to launch, but you won't be doing it alone - we've built a culture of collaboration where everyone, engineers included, helps shape the outcomes we focus on and the work that gets us there. If that sounds like your cup of tea, and you like to work hard, be kind, and have fun while you're at it, you'll be in great company - and I'd love to meet you.




WHAT IMPACT WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU TO MAKE

 - Own a problem space within Communication from discovery and customer research through to shipping and GTM commercialization. You'll bring clarity to new, ambiguous areas and use good judgement to make decisions, knowing when there's enough information to move forward and when it's worth digging deeper.

 - Collaborate closely with partners beyond the PM, designer and engineer trio, including support, product marketing and communications design. At Jane, these partners play a core role in shaping our product, so you'll bring them in early and work with them throughout.

 - Work in the details, side by side with your engineers and designer, because this isn't a strategy-only role. Much of our work is zero to one, so you'll get tactical: refining edge cases, working through trade-offs, testing early prototypes and iterating until the solution is right.

 - Shape how we leverage AI in Communications in support of our group's mission and Jane's. You'll partner with the teams driving Jane's broader AI strategy, building on what they're creating and helping influence where it goes next, because it's not something any one group can do alone.

 - Partner with the design and engineering leads on your team to define the customer problems you're solving and the expected outcomes. Together, you'll build a roadmap around them and make the calls on what to prioritize, what to try first and what to say no to, bringing others along with you as you go.

 - Consistently solve problems that matter to our users, working backwards from each one to a right-sized solution that makes a difference for our customers and for Jane. You'll know our customers and the competitive landscape so well that you become the go-to expert in your space




WHAT EXPERIENCE WE NEED

 - 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS company, including taking a product from 0-to-1. You've spotted an opportunity, won buy-in for it and shaped the plan to bring it to market, from deciding how to validate early ideas through to wider testing like betas, and built the confidence needed to commercialize it.

 - Experience leading planning and strategy work, from shaping a longer-term vision for your space to breaking it into clear priorities. You're a confident facilitator who is comfortable running workshops to explore problems, shape ideas and reach decisions.

 - A track record of shipping products that made a clear difference for customers, rather than a company-wide revenue number you contributed a slice of. You're comfortable defining what success looks like and using data to guide your decisions along the way.

 - Experience shipping AI-powered products and features that solve customer problems, and across the wider company, where you've helped influence a broader AI strategy by building alongside other teams rather than going it alone.

 - You've worked with a broad group of partners and built alignment in a fast-moving environment without slowing things down. You're skilled at communicating complex problems and solutions clearly and bringing senior leaders and other stakeholders into your thinking, which is core to how Jane works. For example, every week, there's a forum where anyone can share their work and get feedback from company leadership

 - If you've worked in communications, healthcare, AI or adjacent spaces like marketing automation, built SMB or B2C products, or navigated a regulated environment, that's a plus, but not required to apply.

"If you don't meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you."




MORE ABOUT JANE

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Jane, we're committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of CAD $117,100 to CAD $182,900. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of CAD $139,000. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this https://vimeo.com/880258361 short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here https://jane.app/documents/hiring/jane_benefits_overview.pdf!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app http://jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.

ashby:visier:d4cbef2a-5935-4ac4-9ae9-449.description:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.


POSITION OVERVIEW



As the Privacy and AI Program Manager, you will operationalize the evolution of our privacy program to encompass the rapidly changing landscape of artificial intelligence. You will embed responsible AI, Privacy by Design, and data protection across our SaaS development lifecycle, directly enabling our strategic shift toward outcomes-based selling. By acting as the operational bridge between legal, product, security, and our customers, you ensure our data practices build the trust required to accelerate deal velocity and drive measurable business impact.

You are a seasoned privacy enabler who thrives on simplifying complexity for diverse stakeholders, ensuring our customers feel confident in our data governance. You will use your deep domain expertise in global privacy and AI regulations to protect our business while empowering our sales and product teams to move fast and win.





WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER:

 - Outcomes-Based Sales Enablement: Accelerate the sales cycle and drive revenue by clearly articulating our privacy posture and AI governance to enterprise prospects, directly supporting our transition to outcomes-based selling.

 - EU AI Act & Global Compliance: Operationalize strategic readiness for the EU AI Act and other emerging global AI regulations, translating complex legislative requirements into actionable product standards.

 - Automated Decision Making Governance: Establish and maintain robust frameworks for transparency, fairness, and human oversight in automated decision-making processes, mitigating bias and ensuring compliance with evolving data protection laws.

 - Responsible AI Integration: Partner internally to conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and review AI use cases, identifying risks early in the software development lifecycle.

 - Data Subject Protection & Trust: Champion the continuous privacy and protection of data subjects across both Visier's internal employee workforce and the millions of employees represented within our customers' data. With a customer base that includes a significant portion of the Fortune 1000 and major multinationals, you will ensure our data governance strategies provide uncompromising security, ethical handling, and compliance for highly sensitive information at global scale.
   
    


WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - Education & Experience: 4+ years of blended experience managing global privacy programs (GDPR, CCPA) within a B2B Enterprise SaaS environment, including direct exposure to AI/ML data governance.

 - Commercial Muscle: A proven track record of supporting enterprise sales and renewal cycles by translating complex privacy controls into customer-facing value and trust.

 - Regulatory Competency: Core understanding of current data protection laws and emerging frameworks (including the EU AI Act and automated decision making legislation), with the ability to operationalize these rules without slowing down the pace of development.

 - Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of data flows, cloud infrastructure, and AI models, enabling you to confidently collaborate with engineering teams on system design.

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Strong communication skills geared toward building productive working relationships with technical, legal, and commercial stakeholders.

 - Agile Problem Solving: A scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves mentality with a proven track record of finding practical, scalable solutions to novel compliance challenges.
   
    



Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.



AI in Hiring
As a people analytics company, we think carefully about how AI is used in decisions that affect people, including our own. Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills. We ask that live interviews be AI-free, so we can get to know how you communicate, think through problems, and describe the work you've actually done. We reserve the right to end the interview early if candidate fraud is suspected.


If you have questions about how AI is used in our process or how your data is handled, review our Visier Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.visier.com/candidate-privacy-notice-and-recruiter-policy/ or reach out to us.

ashby:klue:b8520907-ec93-4731-ab08-91453.description:
AT KLUE https://klue.com/, WE’RE BUILDING THE FUTURE OF COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE




👋 KLUE PRODUCT IS HIRING!

You're the PM who wants the whole thing: the strategy, the roadmap, the pricing conversation, the launch, and the number at the end of it. You're comfortable making the call before you have every answer, and you use AI tools every day because that's how you build now.



You'll report to the VP Product and work alongside a dedicated engineering and design team who are building this product with you. You'll work with Marketing and Sales on how it goes to market, and you'll spend real time with the customers using it. When someone asks where this product is going and why, you're the one with the answer.



Your Mission? To double Klue’s revenue in 12 months by building something customers keep coming back for, Sales can sell on their own, and the market hears about. You own the strategy, the quality bar and the commercial outcome. When the product wins, you win.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

You'll learn what it takes to build an AI-first product from the ground up: how it's shaped, priced, sold and made good. That's a different craft from bolting AI onto something that already exists, and very few companies are doing it at this stage. The scope is clear and the target is big, so a year from now you'll know exactly what you built and what it moved.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the strategy and roadmap. You decide where the Product goes, what gets built, what gets cut and in what order. You'll make the case to our VP, Product and exec team, weigh near-term revenue against longer bets, and stand behind the calls you make. You'll also set the shipping rhythm with the engineering and design team so customers notice the product getting better over time.

 - Run your own discovery. Sit in on customer calls and talk to users directly. Build a repeatable loop that turns feedback into prioritized decisions, bring evidence into roadmap debates, and know the customer base well enough to spot which segment the next bet is for.

 - Set the quality bar for AI. Work with engineering on model quality and evals: what good output looks like and how we measure it. Stay close enough to what's technically possible that you can reshape the roadmap when it shifts. Enterprise customers need to trust an AI product before they rely on it, and you'll define what earns that trust.

 - Collaborate with Sales & Marketing. Guide marketing with positioning. Enable Sales so reps can run the conversation on their own. Partner with Demand Gen on the pipeline this product needs to generate, and bring whatever is blocking deals back into the roadmap.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

We want you to love the role you're in and believe these skills and experiences will help you be successful! You'll know you're nailing it when:

 - Revenue Growth. Product revenue doubles within 12 months.

 - Shipped Changes. A much better version is live within 2 weeks, usage is up, and customers are asking for more without being chased.

 - Retention improves year over year.  Retention on this product improves year over year, and every churn has a known reason that's traceable to a product decision or a deliberate trade-off.

 - The product builds its own pipeline. The product is generating its own pipeline and Sales can run the pitch without pulling you in.

 - Customer Feedback. A running discovery cadence you own, with a clear line from what customers said to what got built.

 - Product Quality. Evals and a defined quality bar are in place for the AI surface, and output quality is trending up against them.

 - Independent Ownership. You run this product without the VP, Product in the detail. Hard calls still get escalated, you just arrive with a recommendation and the thinking behind it, so the conversation starts from your point of view.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Haves

 - 0 to 1 experience. You've taken a product or major product line from nothing to real revenue, and you can walk us through what you got wrong along the way.

 - AI-native. You build with AI tools daily and have a clear view of what models can and can't do today.

 - GTM thinking. You've owned or been accountable for a number, and you treat pricing, packaging and go-to-market as part of the product job.

 - Consumer-grade UX for enterprise buyers. You've built products where the user and the buyer are different people, and you've met a high bar for both.

 - Decisive with incomplete information. You make the call, move, and change course fast when the evidence says to.

 - Hands-on discovery. You talk to customers directly and regularly, and you trust that over a summary.

Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience with a competitive intelligence, market intelligence or research product, or selling into that buyer.

 - Technical enough to dig into evals and model behaviour with engineers yourself.




⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. If you know you have what it takes, even if that’s different from what we’ve described, be sure to explain why in your application.

At Klue, we're committed to building a high-performing team where people feel a strong sense of belonging, can be their authentic selves, and are able to reach their full potential. If there’s anything we can do to make our hiring process more accessible or to better support you, please let us know, we’re happy to accommodate.







WHY KLUE MIGHT BE THE PERFECT FIT FOR YOU

At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark.

If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here.                         



Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate




HOW WE WORK AT KLUE

Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork.

ashby:procurify:8474a8c8-2f96-4b31-a368-.description:
Director, Product Marketing



Location:
USA (100% Remote)
Canada (100% Remote)



Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend.
We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend.

Product marketing sits at the center of how we're understood in that market, and we're hiring a Director to lead it.




ABOUT THE ROLE



Procurify is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to define how we compete and win. You'll own the company narrative, the messaging architecture our go-to-market organization builds on, how we segment and prioritize the market, and the analyst relationships that influence how Procurify is understood.



This is a chance to help define Procurify's next stage of growth as the agentic procurement platform. You'll be at the center of translating that strategy into positioning, messaging, assets, and programs that drive demonstrable impact across our go-to-market organization.



This is a senior seat on the marketing leadership team, with full visibility across the company and regular engagement with executives. You'll lead two Product Marketing Managers. You'll raise their craft, sharpen their judgment, and expand what they're capable of owning, building both the team's impact and their careers as leaders in their own right.



This is a true player-coach role. Your PMMs own their product portfolios, and you'll guide their strategy and raise the quality of their work while directly owning company-level and cross-portfolio initiatives yourself. It's hands-on by design: you get the scope and influence of a senior leader while staying close to the craft.



AI fluency is table stakes for this role. We expect AI to be foundational to how you analyze information, build workflows, create and evaluate work, and scale the team's impact without compromising quality.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




POSITIONING AND MARKET STRATEGY

 - Own Procurify's positioning strategy and define how we differentiate in the procurement market.

 - Build and maintain the company-level narrative and messaging architecture as the single source of truth across all surfaces, and translate it into positioning teams can execute against.

 - Own the AI and agentic narrative: make the platform's intelligence concrete, credible, and differentiated for finance and operations buyers.

 - Own market segmentation and use it to direct where we invest and who we talk to.

 - Own the voice of the customer with deep customer research and win/loss analysis.

 - Use product, customer, funnel, and market data to identify patterns, test assumptions, and turn evidence into clear strategic recommendations.

 - Shape Procurify's analyst relations strategy and narrative, building credible relationships with top-tier analyst firms and influencing how the company and category are represented.

 - Act as a credible external voice on procurement and the agentic shift through analyst briefings, press, and webinars.


GO-TO-MARKET

 - Set the execution standard and quality bar for the function, along with the operating rhythms that keep it consistent.

 - Own launch strategy across the portfolio and decide which messages and formats get tested in the market, in partnership with demand generation.

 - Own the strategy for direct-to-customer communications: launch and product-news emails, in-app posts, in-app tours, and lifecycle journeys.

 - Report and analyze product marketing's contribution to pipeline, adoption, and retention.


AI-FIRST PRACTICE

 - Build an AI-enabled Product Marketing practice that improves the quality, consistency, and scale of the function.

 - Establish shared tools, context, and repeatable workflows across core PMM work, and partner with Marketing’s AI specialists to make Product Marketing a model for effective AI-assisted work.


INTERNAL ALIGNMENT AND ENABLEMENT

 - Influence the roadmap, pricing, packaging, and launch sequencing with market, customer, and competitive insight.

 - Own the enablement deliverable set for each product portfolio with your PMMs, including positioning one-pagers, battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, and objection handling, maintained as living resources in our library rather than launch-day artifacts.

 - Train Sales and Customer Success on messaging, use cases, and differentiation.

 - Set the standard for how competitive intelligence gets gathered and used by go-to-market teams.


TEAM LEADERSHIP AND COACHING

 - Coach two Product Marketing Managers: raise their craft, give direct feedback, hold a high bar on the work, and map a clear path to their next level.

 - Own the team's structure, culture, and operations: the processes, templates, and shared standards that keep output consistent across portfolios, whoever is doing the work.

 - Own the team's plan: what it takes on each quarter, what it defers, and how portfolio coverage is split across the two PMMs.
   
   


EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant Product Marketing leadership experience and direct people management.

 - You’ve owned company-level positioning and messaging for a multi-product or complex SaaS platform, including a meaningful repositioning, category shift, or evolution in market narrative.

 - You’ve led go-to-market strategy across a product portfolio, from segmentation and launch strategy through sales enablement, customer communications, and market adoption.

 - You know how to turn customer, competitive, win/loss, and market insight into decisions on positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and where the business invests.

 - You’ve built credibility with senior executives, Sales, Product, Customer Success, customers, and industry analysts, and can influence decisions without relying on organizational authority.

 - You’ve built and coached a high-performing Product Marketing team, raised the quality bar for the function, and helped marketers meaningfully grow their craft and careers.

 - You’re commercially minded and comfortable measuring Product Marketing against business outcomes, including pipeline, adoption, retention, and competitive performance.

 - You’re AI-fluent in practice, not theory. You’ve changed how a team works using AI, built repeatable workflows around it, and can point to meaningful improvements in the quality or scale of the work.

 - You are an exceptional writer and storyteller who still does the work yourself. You can turn a complex platform into differentiated, credible language that a CFO can understand and repeat.

 - You maintain an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensure it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect your role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
   
   


WHY PROCURIFY?




WE’RE BUILDING A PRODUCT THAT MATTERS.

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.



With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.



The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.



If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.




BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:



 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

 - Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Continuous learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

 - Typical Base Salary Range: 
   
   - Canada: $168,000–$210,000 CAD
   
   - United States: $140,000–$160,000 USD
     
     
     Plus a generous CIP.
     
     (The base pay range for this role depends on location and depth of experience, and doesn't include incentive bonuses, benefits, or equity that form part of your total compensation package.)
     
     


LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.



If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.



Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.



To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:

 - Check out what our customers are saying about us https://www.procurify.com/testimonials

 - Learn more about our agentic procurement platform https://www.procurify.com/product/

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

 

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re seeking a talented and collaborative Senior Product Manager to join us in building innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

 

As a Senior Product Manager at Procurify, you will play a key role in defining and delivering high-impact solutions within one of our core product areas. You will work in a fast-paced, AI-Native product and engineering environment. You will partner closely with your triad of engineering and design, and collaborate across the triple diamond to move quickly from concept to delivery.

 

We are looking for someone who is driven to solve important problems for customers and motivated by the opportunity to create real impact. You thrive in a collaborative environment and see cross-functional partnership as essential to building great products. You will work closely with teams across the company to ensure we are solving the right problems with purpose and clarity.







WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON



Focus on outcomes, not just features

 - You will be responsible for driving meaningful business and customer results. Your work will align with strategic priorities and guide your team to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.



Building great strategy through domain expertise

 - You will be responsible for strategic direction and effective decision-making in your product domains. This will be achieved through your depth of knowledge in your domain and through facilitation with experts within the company.



Act as a strong customer advocate

 - You will represent the voice of the customer through deep curiosity, insight, and empathy. You will champion their needs and ensure that every solution improves their experience and drives value.



Work fast in an AI-Native environment

 - You will operate within a modern product development process that uses rapid prototyping, fast experimentation, and AI tools. You will help identify how AI can unlock better solutions, faster.



Collaborate across the company

 - You will work closely within your product triad and partner across every part of the business. You will build alignment, share context, and ensure that product decisions are grounded in both customer insight and cross-functional collaboration.



Lead with clarity and purpose

 - You will approach product challenges with a strong sense of ownership and focus. You will drive decisions that balance customer needs, technical realities, and business goals, always aiming to deliver exceptional results.



Contribute to product direction

 - You will help shape the product strategy and inform roadmap decisions in your area, you will be responsible for delivering results aligned with its goals.

 


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience in SaaS, fintech, or related industries.

 - Proven product ownership experience within the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You must have deep expertise in at least one core domain:
   
   - Procurement (eg, purchase requisitions, PO management, supplier onboarding, sourcing)
   
   - Accounts Payable (eg, invoice data capture, approval workflows, payment execution)

 - Proven ability to deliver high-impact business and customer outcomes in fast-moving environments

 - Experience working in empowered, cross-functional triads with engineering and design

 - Familiarity with AI-Native development practices and rapid experimentation

 - Strong communication skills and a highly collaborative mindset

 - Analytical thinker with a focus on solving the right problems

 - Clear sense of domain ownership and ability to align work to strategic goals

 - Passion for building meaningful products as part of a high-performing team

 - Excellent project management skills to effectively run discovery, design, and development of initiatives in parallel.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.





WHY PROCURIFY?




HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/.



BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

 - Unlimited responsible time off: Work hard, play harder. All team members can take advantage of our unlimited responsible time off policy.

ashby:procurify:e6871697-5416-40dd-94ef-.description:
SOLUTIONS CONSULTANT

Location: Remote (Canada or U.S.)

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement.

We're hiring an experienced Solutions Consultant to be the technical and domain authority on our sales team. This is the person who can walk into a room with a VP of Finance or a Controller, diagnose their procurement and AP pain points in minutes, and show (not just tell) why Procurify is the better platform. The role partners closely with our CRO, VP of Sales, and Executive Leadership Team to help shape how we win competitive deals.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not an entry-level pre-sales seat. We're looking for someone who has already sold or consulted against the players in our space or similar procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation providers. You'll know how to position a challenger platform to win, and you'll own the technical and domain narrative across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in the mid-market and lower-enterprise segment, partnering closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing.

This role sits at the intersection of deep domain expertise, competitive strategy, and consultative selling. Success looks like shorter sales cycles, higher win rates against named competitors, and a Sales org that is measurably sharper because of the enablement and positioning you bring.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



DOMAIN & COMPETITIVE EXPERTISE

 - Serve as the subject-matter expert on Procurify's platform and on the broader procure-to-pay, spend management, and AP automation landscape.

 - Maintain current, detailed knowledge of key competitors and translate that intelligence into sharp, defensible competitive positioning for Sales and Marketing.

 - Codify win/loss themes, battlecards, and objection-handling assets so the whole Sales team benefits from what you learn in the field.

 - Partner with Product Management to relay competitive gaps, market feedback, and integration needs, and help prioritize what gets built next.


DISCOVERY & DEMO EXCELLENCE

 - Lead structured, consultative discovery to uncover a prospect's procurement and AP workflows, technical environment, and business drivers.

 - Design and deliver compelling, story-driven demos that connect Procurify's capabilities to the prospect's stated business case.

 - Build and maintain a reusable library of demo environments, vertical-specific narratives, and proof points that scale across the team.

 - Conduct technical scoping for both out-of-the-box integrations and custom API integrations to client ERP and accounting systems (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks).


SALES CYCLE & DEAL SUPPORT

 - Partner with Account Executives through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, acting as the technical and strategic co-pilot on every deal that needs one.

 - Own RFP/RFI responses, security and IT questionnaires, and solution documentation that build prospect confidence and speed up procurement decisions.

 - Present to and influence economic buyers and executive stakeholders, including CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance and Procurement, translating technical capability into strategic, financial value.

 - Qualify potential customers while understanding and solving their complex workflow and approval-routing questions.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT & ENABLEMENT

 - Help ramp new Sales hires on demo delivery, discovery technique, and competitive positioning.

 - Get new clients set up for success by enhancing their understanding of the platform and services ahead of handoff to Customer Success.

 - Contribute market, competitive, and win/loss perspective to Procurify's Product Team

 - Other related duties as assigned.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales Consultant role in B2B SaaS, with strong preference for candidates coming from a procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation provider 

 - Deep, hands-on domain knowledge of procurement and accounts payable workflows, purchase-to-pay cycles, approval routing, and financial controls.

 - A proven track record running discovery and delivering demos that have influenced complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise or mid-market deals.

 - Direct experience competing against, or working at, the providers named above, with the ability to speak credibly and specifically to how Procurify differentiates.

 - A consultative, curious, quick-thinking approach: diagnose the business problem first, then map the technical solution.

 - Experience owning technical workstreams within full sales cycles, including RFPs, security reviews, technical scoping, and executive-level presentations.

 - Comfort with ERP and accounting system integrations and API concepts; able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to influence a room of executive stakeholders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?



HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/. If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

WORK WITH AN AMAZING TEAM

LEARN MORE

We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! About  AlayaCare   

 At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.     

 With 600+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.   

 About the Role 

 At AlayaCare, we believe technology can transform how care is delivered, and how people age and heal at home. As Product Marketing Manager, US Home Care, you'll lead product marketing strategy and execution for our US Home Care business, turning product capabilities, market insight, and customer feedback into positioning, go-to-market plans, and enablement that our teams can actually put to use.

 You'll be the driving force behind our Tri-Annual Release process, partnering closely with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Education, and Sales to make sure every release lands with impact. You'll also build a repeatable internal enablement program so colleagues always know what's changing, why it matters, who it's for, and how to talk about it with confidence.

 What You'll Do 

- Own the Tri-Annual release process end-to-end, from planning and readiness through communications, enablement, activation, and follow-up, while setting clear success criteria and rallying stakeholders around measurable US go-to-market results.

- Shape the story: develop compelling value propositions, narratives, pitches, and competitive differentiation, and build the US Home Care buyer journey to support our Land and Expand motion.

- Build and continuously improve our internal enablement program, creating frameworks and assets (learning paths, launch toolkits, talk tracks, demos, FAQs, objection handling, and competitive guidance) that help colleagues sell and support with confidence.

- Establish consistent, repeatable processes alongside our US Market Product Marketing Managers, and measure what matters: awareness, confidence, adoption, and commercial impact.

- Partner with Product, Customer Experience, and Education to drive feature adoption and retention, and own our US buyer personas and competitive research so the whole team stays sharp on the market.

- Contribute to US Home Care thought leadership and market-facing content, refine pricing and packaging alongside the Principal Product Marketing Manager, and manage incoming content requests.

- Use AI thoughtfully and responsibly, in line with AlayaCare's privacy, security, and fairness standards, owning the outcomes of AI-supported work and sharing what you learn with the team.

 What You'll Bring 

- 4 to 5 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in Product Marketing, Strategy, Management Consulting, or a related field, along with a bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Proven experience driving enterprise SaaS go-to-market strategy; broader SaaS experience is a strong asset.

- 3 to 4+ years in healthcare or home care is an asset, ideally with an understanding of payors and business lines.

- Strong analytical and metrics-driven instincts, paired with excellent project management, organizational, communication, interpersonal, decision-making, and time-management skills.

- Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Confluence, Roadmunk, Looker, Amplitude, Asana, or Crayon is an asset.

- Working knowledge of AI, with the ability to apply AI tools to enhance day-to-day work.

 Location and Work Model     

 This role is based in the Greater Toronto Area. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.   

 Why Join  AlayaCare ?     

 Work With Purpose     

 At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.    

 Grow in a High-Trust Culture     

 We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.    

 Balance That Works for You     

 We value flexibility and well-being. From “Wellness Fridays” to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.    

 Benefits That Matter     

- Equity in a well-funded, scaling company.    

- Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.    

- Parental leave top-up and family support programs.    

 Inclusive by Design     

 We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities, both in-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.    

 Ready to Join Us?     

 Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.    

 AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically you will be notified and you may request a human review.    

 We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to careers@alayacare.com   

 At AlayaCare, we consider a range of factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, experience, and market data. These factors may cause compensation to vary. The expected hiring range is what we reasonably anticipate offering for this position at the time of posting.

AlayaCare offers a comprehensive benefits program, which may include medical, dental, wellness, life insurance, equity participation, paid parental leave top up, and paid time off.

This expected hiring range applies only to candidates hired to perform work in Ontario. This role represents an existing vacancy at AlayaCare. AlayaCare uses artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

 Expected Hiring Range
 $85,000 — $120,000 CAD

lever:achievers:33b4e5e0-f9ca-4ff6-972a-.description:
Achievers is an employee recognition and engagement platform, and our mission is to Change the Way the World Works. We help companies celebrate great work, build stronger cultures, and make sure people feel valued. Every day, our platform powers millions of recognition moments for global, multi-generational workforces.  We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the product behind our Milestone and Celebration experiences. This is the part of Achievers that recognizes work anniversaries, birthdays, and service milestones, the moments people tend to remember from their time at a company. You’ll work in a product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, setting the roadmap and leading the work together. When the product works, a hard-earned anniversary or a quiet milestone gets noticed instead of slipping past. Millions of those moments run through what you would build.  Learn more about the domain here: https://www.achievers.com/platform/celebrate/ Why you`ll love this role::
  • Your work will change how millions of people feel about their jobs. Change the Way the World Works is the mission, and this product is one of the places you can watch it happen.
  • You’ll own product strategy for a core part of the platform, reporting to the Digital Product Director who leads our Member Experience portfolio.
  • You’ll work in a true product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, sharing direction and delivery rather than handing off specs.
  • You`ll join a team that values empathy, ownership, and high standards, and gives you room to make decisions that matter.
  • You`ll thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation is encouraged and your voice truly matters.
    • How you'll shape our Milestone and Celebration experiences::
  • Set the roadmap and lead the work alongside your Product Designer and Lead Engineer, across web, mobile, and the channels we integrate with.
  • Understand the admins and program owners who run recognition and the employees who receive it, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
  • Improve the automation that spots employee milestones and sends timely, personal celebrations without creating extra work for admins.
  • Keep the experience feeling personal and authentic rather than automated and generic.
  • Use data, research, and experimentation to guide decisions and measure impact, including participation, recipient response, on-time delivery, and engagement.
  • Work with enterprise customers and teams across Achievers to understand their programs, cultural norms, and configuration needs in different regions.
  • Make sure celebration experiences work at global scale, with localization, multiple languages, and culturally appropriate recognition across regions.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, raising the standard of the work without managing anyone directly.
    • Experience we feel will set you up for success::
  • 5+ years of hand-on product management experience, shipping digital products end to end in SaaS or B2B2C.
  • Advanced experience in a product triad, or close partnership with Design and Engineering with shared ownership of strategy and delivery.
  • Comfort using data, research, and experimentation to decide what to build and to measure results.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align people without relying on authority.
  • A strong interest in building products that people enjoy using.

    • Advantageous but not required

  • Experience in employee experience, engagement, HR tech, or recognition platforms.
  • Experience with automated or triggered experiences, personalization, or messaging and notifications.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations such as Workday or SuccessFactors.
  • Comfort with SQL or BI tools for exploring engagement and sentiment data.
  • Interest in applying new technology and AI to improve product experiences.
